The fix is verified. I will now submit the patch.
The patch was submitted successfully. I will now provide the final summary.

The title of the `Panel` was missing the panel's background style because it was only being styled with the border's partial style. I updated `rich/panel.py` to apply the full panel `style` to the title text using `title_text.stylize_before(style)`, ensuring the title inherits the correct background color.
